body_lead: In a major step towards empowering Anganwadi educators and strengthening their professional and pedagogical capacities, Devendra Fadnavis, Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Chris Lehane, Chief Global Affairs Officer at OpenAI, and Azeez Gupta, Co-founder of Rocket Learning, announced ‘Shiksha Saathi’ at the recently concluded global AI Summit 2026. Rocket Learning signed an agreement with the Government of Maharashtra and OpenAI to launch Shiksha Saathi across the state of Maharashtra.
